mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) may potentiate pyrazinamide's hypertensive effects and there is theoretical risk of tyramine-like pressor response; additionally, pyrazinamide can cause hyperuricemia and hepatotoxicity which may complicate phenelzine therapy.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely if co-administration is necessary; consider alternative antituberculous agents; ensure adequate hepatic and renal function monitoring.
